items.title: Adding FollowOp to your home screen
items.body: On Android: open followop.app in Chrome → tap the three dots menu → tap "Add to Home Screen". On iPhone: open in Safari → tap the share button → tap "Add to Home Screen". The globe icon appears on your home screen — one tap and you're in.

items.title: Free vs Standard vs Pro
items.body: Free gives you 50 contacts, 10 events, 5 Read The Room reads, and 3 Research reads per month. Standard gives you unlimited contacts and events. Pro adds client/referral management, all reports, Special Event Report, calendar view, and unlimited AI features. Upgrade anytime from Settings.

items.title: Activating your account after payment
items.body: After paying on Stripe you will receive a confirmation email with your access code. Go to Settings → scroll to Activate Your Account → enter your email and access code → tap Activate. Your account upgrades instantly. Coupon codes also work as activation codes.

items.title: ⚡ Quick Capture — fastest mode
items.body: Tap the Quick Capture button in the header — always visible at the top of the app. Name and phone or email — saved in 10 seconds. Complete their full profile later by tapping the contact and hitting Edit.

items.title: ⚡ Hot Intro — full capture
items.body: Tap Hot Intro in the Quick Actions grid on the dashboard. Fill in all their details — company, title, notes, which client/referral they connect to, and contact type. Upload a photo of their business card from Gallery and AI fills the form automatically.

items.title: How to scan a business card
items.body: Take a photo of their card with your regular camera app first — it saves to your camera roll automatically. Then in FollowOp tap Hot Intro → Upload from Gallery → select the photo. AI reads the card and fills in the form. Review and save. Works with HEIC, PNG, WebP, and JPEG from any phone.

items.title: The 4 contact types
items.body: ⚡ Hot Intro — Connect them with someone right now — urgent. 📌 Follow Up — Reach out yourself this week. 💡 Recommend — Great for a client or colleague. 🔍 Intel — Good to know — keep in your network.

items.title: Adding a client/referral on the fly
items.body: In the contact capture form tap the "Connect to client?" dropdown and select "+ Add New Client". A quick form slides up — enter the brand name and tier. Complete their full profile from the Clients/Referrals tab later.

items.title: Social links on contacts
items.body: Add LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter/X, and Facebook URLs when capturing or editing a contact. Social links appear as clickable buttons on the contact detail view so you can visit their profiles instantly.

items.title: Photo upload for contacts
items.body: Upload a profile photo or business card image when adding or editing a contact. Photos display on the contact card and in the contact detail view. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC.

items.title: What it does
items.body: Analyzes any image or pasted text to determine how someone communicates — then gives you a personalized follow-up message ready to send. Culturally aware — accounts for relationship-first cultures, communication norms across nationalities, and individual personality signals. Not just Western corporate defaults.

items.title: What you can upload or paste
items.body: Photo of them. Business card. LinkedIn screenshot. Facebook profile. Instagram profile. Twitter/X. Any social media screenshot. Website screenshot. Paste their LinkedIn URL, Instagram handle, bio text, or any info about them. AI reads everything — any platform, any culture, any background.

items.title: The 4 communication types
items.body: Results Driver — direct, data-focused, lead with ROI. Relationship Builder — warm, personal, lead with connection. Detail Architect — thorough, analytical, lead with specifics. Vision Seeker — big picture, creative, lead with possibility. Results are culturally informed — a Relationship Builder from Lagos will get different guidance than one from Manhattan.

items.title: AI disclaimer
items.body: Results are AI-generated and may be incomplete or inaccurate. Use as a starting point — always trust your own read of the person. Cultural assessments are generalizations, not absolutes.

items.title: Limits
items.body: Free and Standard: 5 reads per month. Pro: unlimited. Counter resets at the start of each month.

items.title: What it does
items.body: Take a wide photo or panorama of any room — AI reads the crowd energy, who is there, your opportunity, how to show up, and your perfect opening line. Nothing gets saved — just the intelligence. Available on all plans.

items.title: How to use it
items.body: Tap Vibe The Room on the dashboard. Take a wide photo of the room — sweep across the crowd, the setup, the energy. On iPhone use Panorama mode for best results. Tap Upload from Gallery if you already took the photo. AI delivers room intelligence in seconds.

items.title: Best results tip
items.body: Get as much of the room as possible in one shot. Panorama mode on iPhone works best. The more people and context visible, the more specific the intelligence. Works from any angle — lobby, stage view, crowd shot.

items.title: AI disclaimer
items.body: Room assessment is AI-generated. Use as a guide — your instincts and direct observation always take priority.

items.title: What it does
items.body: AI searches the web for everything about a contact — LinkedIn, Google Business, social media, news mentions, community affiliations, and how to serve them. Results include culturally appropriate follow-up recommendations — adjusts for relationship-first cultures, not just Western business norms.

items.title: Three ways to research
items.body: From Contact — uses their saved name, company, and website automatically. Paste Info — paste their LinkedIn URL, Instagram handle, Facebook URL, website, email signature, or any bio text. Gallery — upload a screenshot of their profile page, business card, or any image.

items.title: Best results tip
items.body: Paste their LinkedIn URL for the most accurate individual intelligence. For businesses paste their Google Business URL or website. The more specific the input the better the output.

items.title: AI disclaimer
items.body: Research is AI-generated and may be incomplete or outdated. Verify important details before acting. Cultural inferences are generalizations — not absolutes.

items.title: Limits
items.body: Free: 3 per month. Standard: 10 per month. Pro: unlimited.

items.title: Logging an event
items.body: Tap Log Event on the dashboard. Fill in event name, date, venue, and which client/referral you are representing. Log conversations, contacts captured, intros made, and social posts. Add a summary and community intel. ROI score is calculated automatically.

items.title: Tagging contacts to events
items.body: When capturing a contact select the event from the dropdown — your logged events appear automatically. This is what powers the Special Event Report and keeps your network organized by room.

items.title: Saving a Vibe The Room report to an event
items.body: After running Vibe The Room tap Save to Current Event. The room intelligence saves to your most recently logged event — keeps everything connected.

items.title: Calendar view
items.body: Tap the Calendar button in the Events tab or on the Dashboard. View all your logged events in a monthly grid. Navigate between months with arrow buttons. Tap any event on a date to view its details. Great for tracking your event activity over time.

items.title: Editing and deleting events
items.body: Each event card now has Edit and Delete buttons. Tap Edit to update event details including name, date, venue, client/referral represented, and all activity metrics. Tap Delete to remove an event permanently.

items.title: Adding a client/referral
items.body: Tap the Clients/Referrals tab → Add. Fill in brand name, contact name, service tier, elevator pitch, target rooms and contacts, and what not to say. Add their social media handles so you can tag them in posts from the room instantly.

items.title: Editing and deleting clients/referrals
items.body: Each client/referral card has Edit and Delete buttons. Tap Edit to update all details including photo, social links, brand info, service tier, and notes. Tap Delete to remove a client/referral permanently.

items.title: Service tiers
items.body: 30-Day Pilot — $2,000. In The Room — $1,500/month. Maximum Presence — $3,000/month. Government — custom. Set the tier when adding a client — it appears in all reports.

items.title: Client/referral color coding
items.body: Each client/referral gets a color automatically. Contact cards show a colored tag when linked to a client/referral — easy visual sorting at a glance.

items.title: Social links for clients/referrals
items.body: Add LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter/X, and Facebook for your clients/referrals. Access them quickly from the client detail view to tag in social posts from events.

items.title: ⚡ Special Event Report — most important
items.body: Generate immediately after leaving an expo, pop-up, or brand event. Tap Special Event Report on the dashboard. Select client/referral and event — FollowOp pulls all tagged contacts, sorts Hot Intros first, and generates a full report. Copy and send to your client within the hour.

items.title: Weekly report
items.body: Fill in your week's activity — events, conversations, contacts, intros, key people, community intel. Tap Generate and the report copies to your clipboard. Paste into email and send every Friday or Monday morning.

items.title: Monthly summary
items.body: Covers the full month including recommended events for next month and goals. Send at end of month with your invoice.

items.title: Brief export options
items.body: After generating any report (Weekly, Monthly, or Special Event), use the Brief Export modal to download as a file, copy to clipboard, or email the report directly. Multiple export formats give you flexibility in how you deliver reports to clients.

items.title: PDF Contact Brief
items.body: Open any contact → tap Research This Contact → results save to their profile. Then open the contact → tap the PDF icon to export a professional one-pager. Hand to your VA — they have everything they need to follow up. Free: 3/month. Standard: 10/month. Pro: unlimited.

items.title: Where is my data stored?
items.body: Your data lives on your device. It does not sync between devices yet. Export regularly — especially before clearing your browser or switching phones. FollowOp reminds you to export every 10 new contacts.

items.title: Exporting contacts
items.body: Settings → Export Contacts to CSV. Downloads a spreadsheet with all contact info, notes, event tags, client/referral links, and social links. Open in Google Sheets or send to your VA.

items.title: Importing contacts
items.body: Settings → Import Contacts from CSV. Restore contacts from a previous export. Enhanced CSV import handles BOM characters, normalizes line endings, and supports comprehensive field mapping for over 20 contact data fields including social links. Detects and skips duplicates automatically.

items.title: Saving a contact to your phone
items.body: Open any contact → tap Save to Phone. Downloads a vCard with their photo. Opens in your phone's contacts app — tap to save. Works on both Android and iPhone.

items.title: Upgrading to Pro or Standard
items.body: Settings → tap Upgrade to Pro or Upgrade Standard. Pay on Stripe. Check your email for your access code. Come back to Settings → enter your email and code → Activate.

items.title: Using a coupon code
items.body: Enter your coupon code on the Stripe checkout page. The same coupon code also works as your activation code — enter it in the activation field in Settings after payment.

items.title: Important — please read
items.body: FollowOp uses AI to generate communication insights, contact research, and room assessments. Results are AI-generated and may be incomplete, inaccurate, or not reflective of an individual's actual communication style or cultural background. Cultural and personality assessments are generalizations — not absolutes. Always apply your own judgment. FollowOp and Ashé & Ember Co. are not responsible for decisions made based on AI-generated insights.

items.title: Clients renamed to Clients/Referrals
items.body: The Clients tab is now Clients/Referrals throughout the app — navigation, modals, reports, and help documentation all reflect the updated terminology to better represent both client and referral partner relationships.

items.title: Calendar view for events
items.body: New monthly calendar grid accessible from the Events tab and Dashboard. Navigate between months, see events plotted on dates, and tap to view event details.

items.title: Photo upload for contacts and clients/referrals
items.body: Upload profile photos or business card images when adding or editing contacts and clients/referrals. Photos display on cards and detail views.

items.title: Social links everywhere
items.body: Add LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter/X, and Facebook URLs to contacts and clients/referrals. Social links appear as clickable buttons for instant access to profiles.

items.title: Editable event logs
items.body: Edit and delete events directly from the Events tab. Update all event details including venue, client/referral represented, and activity metrics.

items.title: Editable clients/referrals
items.body: Edit and delete clients/referrals directly from the Clients/Referrals tab. Update all profile details including photo and social links.

items.title: Enhanced CSV import
items.body: CSV import now handles BOM characters, normalizes line endings, and supports comprehensive field mapping for over 20 data fields including social links.

items.title: Brief export options
items.body: New Brief Export modal for reports — download, copy to clipboard, or email reports directly after generation.

items.title: Back buttons on all modals
items.body: Every modal dialog now has a ← Back button at the top for easier navigation.

items.title: Research from contact detail
items.body: Tap 'Research This Contact' button on any contact detail view to auto-load their data into the research modal and trigger AI research instantly.
